app.name: WiiTale
app.long_description:
A native Wii port of UNDERTALE, running the original game's bytecode through a GX renderer.
Put the game's data.win, the generated textures.wtex and its .ogg music files in this folder.
Controls: hold the Wii Remote sideways. D-pad moves, 2 confirms, 1 cancels, minus opens the menu, HOME exits. Nunchuk and Classic Controller work too.
Minus + Plus toggles pointer steering, 1 + Plus opens the room warp menu, Minus + 1 opens the save slot manager.
